title: T. T. Brown apparatus left in the Eureka garage

tellings.quote:
Well, the Borderland Society,
they had connections with Brown. They
had some apparatus still left in the
garage that I couldn't bring,

plain: A group in Eureka, California called the Borderland Society, which had ties to the inventor Thomas Townsend Brown, still had some of Brown's apparatus sitting in a garage. Brown was known for electrical devices said to work against gravity. A UFO researcher named Clas Svahn says he saw it himself but could not bring it away with him.
